feed.title: Adden Lab
feed.subtitle: The Adden lab is interested in the evolution and neural basis of behaviour, particularly maternal care behaviours. We study tsetse flies to understand how sensory and neural systems change to support changing behavioural demands in both mothers and offspring.

entry.title: Job Alert
entry.content:
We are recruiting two PhD students to join the team!

One BBSRC SWBio DTP-funded project on the olfactory ecology and behaviours of tsetse fly larvae https://bpb-eu-w2.wpmucdn.com/blogs.bristol.ac.uk/dist/f/373/files/2026/10/Project_3728.pdf via https://www.swbio.ac.uk (deadline December 2)

And one internally funded project on the evolution of maternal care behaviours in flies: https://www.findaphd.com/phds/project/funded-phd-evolution-of-maternal-care-behaviours-in-flies/?p200853 (deadline December 13)
